scope: German champions as recognised by the DFB: national championship finals 1902-03 to 1962-63 (format "final") and the Bundesliga from 1963-64 (format "league"). East German DDR-Oberliga champions (1948-1991) are not included: the DFB title list does not count them, and FootSimu's Bundesliga is the unified German league
source: https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duitchamp.html (RSSSF: finals 1902/03-1962/63 with both finalists, Bundesliga champions)
https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duitYY.html / duitYYYY.html (RSSSF Bundesliga final tables 1963-64 to 2025-26: top three and points)
Wikipedia season articles (YYYY–YY Bundesliga) league tables (cross-check, points)
German Wikipedia season articles (Fußball-Bundesliga 1968/69, 1969/70, 1987/88, 1993/94) used as a tie-breaking third source

fieldNotes.footsimuId: ESPN team id (the id FootSimu uses); present for some clubs that are not in FootSimu leagues
fieldNotes.footsimuSlug: club page slug on footsimu.com, only for clubs in a FootSimu league in 2026-27
fieldNotes.footsimuPath: club page path under the league the club plays in now, without locale
fieldNotes.points: final points (2 per win until 1994-95, 3 from 1995-96); null for seasons decided by a final
fieldNotes.season: finals era seasons are labelled by the season the final ended (e.g. the 1903 final is 1902-03); the DFB lists those titles by the year of the final
fieldNotes.name: club name used in the source for that season
fieldNotes.currentName: club as known today (FootSimu name where the club is in FootSimu); "(defunct)" marks clubs that no longer exist
fieldNotes.tournament: always null for Germany (kept for schema consistency)
fieldNotes.tiedWith: not used: no shared positions in German records
fieldNotes.strippedChampion: not used: no German title was revoked; 1903-04 and 1921-22 were never awarded (status abandoned)
